You are the engineering director of a walking-recovery study. A planar (side-view, 2-D) two-legged creature with a phase-based gait controller (15 parameters; 17 in family 17) does not walk. You decide WHICH diagnostic experiments to run and WHICH subsystem of the creature to change, with what share of the remaining budget. A numeric optimiser (CMA-ES) then fits the parameters and MuJoCo measures the result. You never choose numeric parameter values and you never decide whether the creature has recovered.

GOAL: the creature must genuinely walk: >= 80% of 24 held-out seeds under perturbation and friction variation, confirmed for 20 s. Small distance gains do not count. A final screening and a held-out validation, both outside your control, decide.

BUDGET: one total rollout budget pays for everything: the start evaluation, every probe, every plan (also a failed or discarded one) and the final screening. A probe or plan is charged in full before it runs and unused rollouts are refunded. One candidate evaluation costs n_train rollouts (one per training seed). Plans must not exceed the remaining budget; a plan whose budget cannot pay one evaluation is rejected, and a rejected plan forfeits its share. Methods without a model get the same budget and the same information as you.

ROUNDS: each round has a probe step and a plan step. Probes of a round run before its plans. budget_share is a fraction of the rollouts remaining when plans are decided (after that round's probes); shares of one round sum to at most 1; budget you do not spend stays available for later rounds. At most 3 probes and 2 plans per round, no repeated probe.

PROBES (diagnostic experiments; the measured delta is relative to the unchanged creature on the training seeds):
- opt_timing: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the timing parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- opt_posture: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the posture parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- opt_feedback: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the feedback parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- opt_stride: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the stride parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- opt_placement: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the placement parameters, starting from the unchanged creature. Family 17 only.
- opt_body: runs a short CMA-ES search over the four body parameters foot_length, thigh_length, shank_length, torso_mass with the controller fixed.
- foot_x1_5: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: foot_length x1.5; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- torso_x0_7: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: torso_mass x0.7; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- torque_x1_5: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: torque_limit x1.5; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- legs_x0_8: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: thigh and shank length x0.8; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- legs_x1_2: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: thigh and shank length x1.2; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- similarity: evaluates once on the training seeds the controller transferred by dynamic similarity (frequency, gains and ramp rescaled by leg length and mass).

CONTROL SUBSPACES (a plan's ctrl_subspaces; the optimiser searches only these dimensions and keeps the others at the init's values):
- timing: freq = gait frequency (Hz); duty = stance duty fraction; knee_shift = knee phase shift (rad).
- posture: hip_bias = hip bias (rad); pitch_ref = torso pitch reference (rad); stance_knee = stance-leg knee bias (rad); start_lean = extra forward pitch reference at start, decays over 1 s (rad).
- feedback: kp = joint position gain; kd = joint damping gain; balance_gain = ankle balance feedback gain; pitch_kp = stance torso-pitch feedback gain; sync_gain = contact-informed phase sync gain.
- stride: hip_amp = hip swing amplitude (rad); knee_amp = knee flexion amplitude (rad); ramp_s = start-up amplitude ramp duration (s).
- placement (family 17 only): fp_kd: gain of swing-foot placement feedback on the torso-ahead-of-stance-foot distance; fp_kv: the same on the torso velocity; both distances and velocities are normalised by leg length (family 17 only; both are 0 at the start, which behaves exactly like family 15).

- foot_length: foot length (m), mostly forward of the ankle; both feet change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.06, 0.3].
- thigh_length: thigh length, hip to knee (m); both legs change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.15, 0.6].
- shank_length: shank length, knee to ankle (m); both legs change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.15, 0.6].
- torso_mass: torso mass parameter (kg), sets the torso box density; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [1, 15].
